source.font: Noto Sans CJK KR Bold (KR face of NotoSansCJK-Bold.ttc, Debian/Ubuntu fonts-noto-cjk package)
source.extraction: fontTools 4.65, RecordingPen per contour, SVG path commands, 2026-10-19 (Claude)
source.units: font units, unitsPerEm 1000, y axis points UP (flip with translate(0 880) scale(1 -1) for screen)
notes: Each entry lists the glyph's contours unchanged, with bounds [xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax].

노 is ONE joined contour in this font (ㄴ rests on ㅗ's stem). The Syllable Lift Study splits it at y=333: ㄴ = M135 767V333H791V439H268V767Z, ㅗ = M393 333V122H41V15H880V122H526V333Z. This split is a manual edit, not font data.
Matched command structures (directly interpolable): 나 ㄴ <-> 난 initial ㄴ (MVHCLCVHZ); 나 ㅏ <-> 난 ㅏ <-> standalone ㅏ (MVHVHVHVZ); 난 final ㄴ <-> standalone ㄴ (MVHVHVZ).
Not matched: initial ㄴ (curved, upturned foot) <-> standalone ㄴ (straight).
